name: CredUI.DLL Loaded By Uncommon Process
description: Detects loading of "credui.dll" and related DLLs by an uncommon process. Attackers might leverage this DLL for potential use of "CredUIPromptForCredentials" or "CredUnPackAuthenticationBufferW".
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Other legitimate processes loading those DLLs in your environment.
query: ((file.path:(*\\credui.dll OR *\\wincredui.dll)) OR (file.pe.original_file_name:(credui.dll OR wincredui.dll))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\explorer.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\regedit.exe)))) AND (NOT (process.executable:*\\opera_autoupdate.exe OR (process.executable:(*\\procexp64.exe OR *\\procexp.exe)) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Users\\* AND process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\* AND process.executable:*\\Teams.exe) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Users\\* AND process.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\OneDrive\\*)))
